name: ANSI dimmer switch plan symbol
summary: US plan symbol SD for a wall dimmer controlling a lighting group.
description: A wall dimmer in US plan practice is drawn as S with subscript D, sometimes with a wattage note. The switch leg links it to the dimmed group, and three-way dimming is shown by pairing SD with S3 or with a companion device.

The reader should check dimmer type against LED driver compatibility, and whether the dimmer controls a low-voltage 0-10 V signal or switches line power directly. The plan symbol is identical for both. SD does not specify dimming technology, load or whether multi-gang derating applies.
readingNotes: Check dimming technology in the fixture schedule.
Note multi-gang derating for ganged dimmers.
distinction: The IEC dimmer uses a variability arrow on a switch mark; the US form uses the D subscript.
